description: Cruise ID for Bering Sea bottom trawl surveys. YYYY-01 indicates EBS surveys, YYYY-02 indicates NBS surveys. See RACEBASE or AKFIN for additional NOAA cruise metadata
Alpha-numeric designation for the station established in the design of AFSC standardized surveys.
Unit of effort for AFSC bottom trawl surveys: computed by distance towed*mean net width
Station-level snow crab density, calculated as CPUE
Unique ID for hepatopancreas sample. AKK=Alaska Knight samples, V=Vesteraalen samples
ID number of the vessel used to collect data for that haul associated with vessel name.
Uniquely identifies a sampling event (haul) within an AFSC cruise. It is a sequential number, in chronological order of occurrence.
Sex of specimen sampled. 1=Male, 2-Female
Carapace width of specimen sampled
Chela height (males) or clutch code (females) used to determine maturity. 0 clutch code for females signifies 000, or immature
Whole crab weight of specimen sampled (prior to dissection). Only individuals with no missing limbs weighed
2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat
2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat PLUS 1-2 grams of hepatopancreas
2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat PLUS 1-2 grams of hepatopancreas after drying at 70C for 48hrs
2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat
2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat PLUS 1-2 grams of muscle tissue from 1st walking leg during dissection
2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat PLUS 1-2 grams of muscle tissue after drying at 70C for 48hrs
2019 samples only: date of dissection at KFRC (crab frozen whole in 2019 and dissected post-freeze)
Additional comments recorded during at-sea dissections
Maturity of specimen sampled. 0=Immature, 1=Mature
Latitude of specimen collection. Designates latitude at start of haul for AFSC standardized surveys
Longitude of specimen collection. Designates longititude at start of haul for AFSC standardized surveys
Bottom depth at station for AFSC standardized surveys
Bottom temperature at sampling station
Year of specimen collection
Pre-defined spatial sampling strata in the Bering Sea. Regions 1-6 correspond with EBS BSIERP regions, Regions 7-9 correspond with NBS BSIERP regions.
Large marine ecosystem: EBS=eastern Bering Sea, NBS=northern Bering Sea
